name: Space Survivor VR AR
storyline:
A man got drifted in deep space during the early International space station (ISS) missions back in the 70's, luckily he survived because his suite was having a hibernation test technology, then he awake when the system detects a spaceship near which was the ISS in the future, totally abandoned and almost powerless.
His role is first to save himself by catching the passing by Station rails and then try to get it back to work, unlocking the doors to its several sections and discover the reason of its failure and fix it.
During his mission he would experience all the regular life routines from consuming space food to survive and using the space toilets to generate the oxygen for breathing.
summary:
Experience life in space with Space Survivor - the ultimate International Space Station simulator! Explore the ISS, conduct science experiments, survive in microgravity.
Welcome to Space Survivor, the International Space Station Simulator, the most realistic space station simulator available on the App Store.
